summary: Retest of Step 4 wizard fix in NewMission.jsx (frontend only). The fix relocated computePricing into the step===3 handler. VERIFIED PASS end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. Full wizard flow exercised: intake → scope → caliper 1.25" (tearoff branch) → Continue → Step 4 pricing now renders with pricing-table-body (11 line items), pricing-final-total ($39,775.81), pricing-lock-mode (INSURANCE 20/25 O&P) all visible. Continue → Step 5 preflight (5 rows, all OK) → AUTHORIZE → backend /launch completed in ~120s (Claude Sonnet 4.6) → navigated to /mission/23312050-71fe-45f2-9e1f-308ed99814bb. Mission dashboard renders the 3D photogrammetry mesh image and all 4 AI agent panels populated with rich multi-sentence narratives referencing ANOM-01..07 IDs, thermal deltas, GPS coordinates, Xactimate tags (RFG DECK, RFG FLASH, RFG SEAL), confidence scores, and KY State Farm SLA references. AERIAL RECON AUTHORIZED toast shown, RECON COMPLETE badge visible. Original Step 4 blank bug is fully resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: NewMission.jsx fix is correct and minimal: step===3 handler now does submitCaliper → computePricing → setPricing → setStep(4); step===4 handler simply advances to 5. No regression introduced. Render guard `{step === 4 && pricing && ...}` now satisfied at mount.

Minor: launch endpoint takes ~90-150s due to Claude Sonnet 4.6 generating four narrative reports. The button correctly shows 'TRANSMITTING…' and is disabled via `busy`, but consider adding a more descriptive progress indicator (e.g., 'Generating forensic narrative…') for better UX during the wait.

Minor (carried from iteration 1): server.py preflight gate still requires drone_battery_percentage == 100 (strict) — any user toggle on a single field will reject launch with 400. Demo only, but worth relaxing to >=90.

rca_of_the_issue: Resolved. Original RCA: computePricing was inside the step===4 next() branch so pricing was null when Step 4 mounted, blank render. Fix: computePricing relocated to step===3 branch (NewMission.jsx lines 75-81). Verified.
